scope: First bounded localization experiment; source-isolated adaptation with unresolved inherited exposure
target_rule: the other embryo; all retained checkpoints and predictions frozen before scoring
natural_proposal_training_frames: all existing source-embryo pilot and assessment frames
natural_match_rule: mutual nearest proposal/annotated-GT; other-GT distance margin >=2um; unknown real proposals ignored

features.plane_selection: nearest isotropic slice to query; bilinear token sampling in plane
features.normalization: pinned Cellpose normalize_img defaults, norm3D=true, full native volume before crops
features.resize: pinned Cellpose resize_image_3d to anisotropy=4 with OpenCV half-pixel query mapping
features.patch_sampling: trilinear native normalized intensity, border replication, clamp [-1,5]
features.geometry_features: query displacement from nearest native voxel in micrometers; no global position or embryo identity

training.loss: weighted SmoothL1 physical displacement, beta=1um; separate 50/50 natural-versus-jitter batches when both exist
training.target_selection: none; final fixed horizon checkpoint only
training.normalization_fit: none; sample-wise feature LayerNorm, frozen full-volume intensity recipe

evaluation.ranking_and_count: unchanged from frozen Cellpose proposal bank

next_stages: Encoder unfreezing requires a useful frozen-feature arm; new-query head requires justified negative support; scratch own-proposal control is separate
